title: Q3 Roadmap: Private Deployment Sequencing, OKR Alignment, and Rollout Playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Define and sequence the Q3 roadmap for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features, align to company OKRs for reliability and enterprise sales, and produce an executable rollout playbook for pilot customers.

Scope: feature prioritization across RBAC & SSO, network topology (VPC peering + Private Connect), upgrade path for on-prem appliances, audit logging & KMS integrations, and installer/upgrade UX. Includes operational runbook, rollout gating criteria, and metrics for OKR tracking.

Deliverables:
- Prioritized feature backlog with sequencing rationale and ETA windows (Q3 milestone buckets).
- OKR mapping doc linking each feature to: Objective (Enterprise Expansion), Key Results (pilot signups, MTTR, percentage private traffic).
- Rollout playbook: pilot selection criteria, canary plan, rollback steps, customer communications template, support SLAs.
- Security & compliance checklist and trigger plan for formal audits.
- Success metrics dashboard spec (Console + BI queries).

Acceptance criteria:
- Product, Eng, and Security leadership sign-off on feature sequence and trade-offs.
- Dependencies (ENG-2987, ENG-3021) have clear owners and timelines in sprint plans.
- Pilot-ready implementation for at least one Fortune 500 customer with signed NDA by end of Q3.
- Monitoring queries and dashboard panels defined and implemented in staging.

Key risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Upgrade path complexity for on-prem appliances could delay pilots. Mitigation: Add a dedicated engineering spike in cycle 2026-Q2 to verify installer rollback and automated health checks.
- Risk: KMS integrations require customer-specific legal & Ops approvals. Mitigation: Prebuild adapter patterns and templates; escalate to Security/Legal for playbook.
- Risk: Network topology (VPC peering limitations) introduces regional variability. Mitigation: Prioritize private-connect design and include fallback routing via encrypted tunnels.

Timeline (high level):
- March (planning): finalize backlog and OKR mapping; begin security review.
- April–May (build): implement RBAC/SSO scaffolding, audit logging plumbing, and KMS adapter prototype.
- June (stabilize & pilot): run internal integration tests, deploy pilot to 1–2 customers, iterate on rollout docs.

Metrics for OKRs (how we’ll measure success):
- KR1: Onboard 3 paying private deployment pilots by EOW Q3 (metric: pilot_count).
- KR2: Achieve <150ms median request latency for private-hosted inference at 95th percentile in pilot traffic (metric: latency_p95_ms).
- KR3: Reduce incident MTTR for private deployments to <60 minutes (metric: incident_mttr_minutes).
- KR4: Complete security sign-off with no critical findings (metric: security_findings_severity).

Stakeholders: Product (Aisha Kapoor), Platforms/Infra (Liam Chen), Security (Marta Ruiz), Solutions Engineering (Omar Patel), Sales AE leads (Nina Sorensen).

Notes and constraints:
- Budget: Dedicated engineering allocation for Q3 has been provisionally approved pending this plan.
- Legal: NDA template needs minor updates for on-prem access; coordinate with Legal by 2026-03-25.
- Customer comms: Prepare standard feature matrix and migration FAQ for pilot customers.

Next steps:
1) Host cross-functional roadmap workshop week of 2026-03-17 to validate sequencing and blockers.
2) Finalize OKR mappings and circulate to execs by 2026-03-24.
3) Create sub-issues for each milestone (ENG tickets + Implementation tasks) and assign owners.
